title: Signature Global Q1 FY27 Pre-Sales: A Closer Look at Growth
description: Signature Global reported pre-sales of ₹1,970 crore for Q1 FY27, indicating strong operational activity. This figure represents a robust 25% quarter-on-quarte.

faq.q: What are "pre-sales" in a real estate context?
faq.a: Pre-sales refer to the value of property units booked or sold by a developer to customers before the project is fully constructed or delivered. These are commitments from buyers, often secured with booking amounts and initial instalments.

faq.q: Why do investors focus on pre-sales instead of just revenue?
faq.a: Pre-sales are a leading indicator of a real estate company's future revenue and cash flow. They show market demand and the strength of a developer's project pipeline long before the revenue is officially recognised on the books.

faq.q: What is the difference between QoQ and YoY growth?
faq.a: QoQ (Quarter-on-Quarter) growth compares a company's performance in the current quarter to the immediate previous quarter. YoY (Year-on-Year) growth compares the current quarter's performance to the same quarter in the previous year, providing a better long-term trend perspective by smoothing out seasonality.

faq.q: How does a new project launch impact pre-sales?
faq.a: A successful new project launch, especially one that is well-received by the market, can significantly boost a developer's pre-sales figures for that quarter. It indicates fresh demand and adds to the company's sales pipeline.

faq.q: Should I invest in a real estate stock solely based on strong pre-sales?
faq.a: No. While strong pre-sales are positive, it's crucial to look at other factors like the company's debt levels, project completion track record, land bank, regulatory approvals, and overall market conditions before making an investment decision.

faq.q: Are pre-sales guaranteed revenue for the company?
faq.a: Pre-sales are commitments, but they are not guaranteed revenue until the property is handed over and all payments are received. There can be cancellations, though developers typically factor a certain percentage of cancellations into their projections.

faq.q: Where can I find official information on corporate results?
faq.a: Companies typically release their corporate results on stock exchange websites (like NSE or BSE in India) and on their own investor relations sections of their official websites. Reputable financial news outlets also report on these results.
